purpose: Permit a frozen evaluation study after explicitly diagnosed development numerical failures, without declaring these failures passed or relaxing acceptance tolerances.
requirements: All structural checks, core tests and host-I/O tests must pass; development speech must pass. Reproduce the documented precision diagnosis before freezing. Unknown failures stop evaluation. Final status remains completed_with_numerical_failures (exit 2) when any numerical test fails.
diagnosis: Full-scale alternating preemphasis equals correctly rounded binary32 of the float64 reference but loses 6.25% of a small DC imbalance; ideal float64 continuation still exceeds the MFCC target. Tiny Mel energies close to 1e-12 amplify frontend/FFT quantization in ln. Tone weak bands are also sensitive. This is a measured limit of this scalar binary32 implementation, not a proof about every float32 algorithm.
invariants: Do not alter input PCM, Python truth, shared equations, 1e-12 log floor, coefficients or final target to hide failures. This policy is fixed before evaluation and does not whitelist evaluation failures.
